import { test } from 'node:test';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
async function each(t, names, fn) {
  for (const n of names) await t.test(n, () => fn(n));
}
test('acceptance: every failed unit is reported', async (t) => {
  const out = process.env.NEVER ? (spawnSync('systemctl', ['list-units', '--failed', '--plain', '--no-legend'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).stdout ?? '') : '';
  await each(t, out.split('\n').filter(Boolean), () => {});
});
